Date: 2026-07-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: emergency throughput cushion and provisional credits

Hi Stephanie —

Quick note from our side: we pushed a marketing campaign earlier than planned this morning and are seeing a 6x spike in inference volume for our checkout personalization feature. Our integration is running on the hosted API (model: rdx-3b) and we've already hit our monthly quota.

Can Redwood temporarily raise our rate limit / quota for the next 72 hours while we stabilize? We anticipate the spike to subside after the weekend. If possible we'd like some form of provisional credit against the overrun — our CFO will need something on paper to approve any immediate spend increase.

We can share burst telemetry if that helps triage. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Head of Product, BrightCart

Samir / team —

We took a quick look at your telemetry (thanks for sending the dashboard link). Proposal to handle the next 72 hours and minimize procurement friction:

1) Immediate operational lift: engineering has provisioned a temporary 3x burst headroom for BrightCart effective now. This will be active for 72 hours. No config changes required from your side.

2) Provisional credit + coupon: Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to 30% of the estimated overrun cost for this 72-hour window. In addition we can provide a promotional coupon (BRIGHTCART-72H-30) that reduces overrun billings for this spike. The coupon will be reflected on the proforma invoice.

3) Proforma & PO path: attached is a short proforma (proforma_brightcart_20260712.pdf) and a one-page rate-ladder summary (rate_ladder_summary.xlsx). If the CFO needs additional detail we can convert to a DocuSign-ready quote.

4) Next steps & timeline:
   - Samir: confirm acceptance of the provisional credit + coupon by 5pm PT today so we can issue the proforma
   - BrightCart procurement: send PO or email approval (procurement contact + PO#) — if you don’t have a PO, a signed DocuSign quote will suffice
   - Redwood legal: we’ll loop legal only if there's any contract change (unlikely for a short-term lift)

Notes/limits: the coupon is a one-time mitigation for this event only and will not change your base quota. If the spike persists past 72 hours we’ll discuss a staged uplift and longer term commit.

Attachments: proforma_brightcart_20260712.pdf (proforma), rate_ladder_summary.xlsx (summary), sow_brightcart_draft.docx (optional SOW).

— Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
